sources.citation: Diyānat (Dianat), Leylā. 1395 [2016]. Farāyand-e hamguni dar zabān-e Lāri [The assimilation process in the Lari language]. Do-faslnāme-ye zabānšenāsi-ye guyešhā-ye Irāni (Journal of Iranian Dialect Linguistics, Shiraz University) 1(1): 53-72
sources.note: Does not state where stress falls. Literature review p. 56 reports second-hand that Kamioka & Yamada (1358 [1979]) recorded 1000 Lari words, extracted the phoneme system and 'also briefly discussed stress in this language' (mokhtasari darbāre-ye takye). Bibliography names the Persian MA theses on Lari phonology: Ahmadniā 1385 (Razi Univ., generative phonology of Achomi), Kāmyāb 1370 and Sami'i 1371 (Shiraz).

tone.quote: 6. В области фонетики для ларских диалектов характерен специфический огубленный гласный, продвинутый вперед ... Для них характерен также дифтонг ... а в области консонантизма характерен ламбдаизм (l < *d) и (преимущественно в говоре Гарраша) зеташизм ... Ларский вокализм представлен гласными: a, å, e, ē, i, o, u, ü (гар. ö) ... Консонантизм: p, t, k, b, d, g ...
tone.translation: 6. In phonetics, the Lar dialects are characterised by a specific fronted rounded vowel ... They are also characterised by a diphthong ... and in the consonant system by lambdacism (l < *d) and (mainly in the Gerash variety) zetacism ... Lar vocalism is represented by the vowels a, å, e, ē, i, o, u, ü (Gerash ö) ... Consonantism: p, t, k, b, d, g ...
tone.check: quotation verified in source (minor differences in wording)
